There aren't any trees, flowers or lakes.
Nobody lives there except a small community of scientists.
passageLines.ko: 소수의 과학자 공동체를 제외하고는 아무도 그곳에 살지 않습니다.

passageLines.text: They live on special bases.
The biggest base is called McMurdo Station.
passageLines.ko: 가장 큰 기지는 맥머도 기지라고 불립니다.

passageLines.text: 1,000 people live there during the summer.
passageLines.ko: 여름 동안에는 천 명의 사람들이 그곳에 삽니다.

passageLines.text: But only 200 people live there during the winter.
passageLines.ko: 하지만 겨울 동안에는 단 200명만이 그곳에 삽니다.

passageLines.text: Antarctica has a short summer and a very long winter.
passageLines.ko: 남극은 짧은 여름과 아주 긴 겨울을 가지고 있습니다.

passageLines.text: The summer lasts from October to February.
The winter lasts from March to September.
The sun stays in the sky for 24 hours a day during the summer.
passageLines.ko: 여름 동안에는 태양이 하루 24시간 내내 하늘에 떠 있습니다.

passageLines.text: Winters are dark and cold.
Temperatures can drop as low as –62 degrees Celsius!
Antarctica is the home of the Emperor Penguins.
Penguins are a type of bird.
Like most birds, they have wings, feathers and beaks.
passageLines.ko: 대부분의 새들처럼, 펭귄도 날개, 깃털, 부리를 가지고 있습니다.

passageLines.text: But unlike most birds, they cannot fly.
passageLines.ko: 하지만 대부분의 새들과는 달리, 펭귄은 날 수 없습니다.

passageLines.text: Emperor Penguins are the tallest variety of penguin.
passageLines.ko: 황제펭귄은 펭귄 중에서 가장 키가 큰 종류입니다.

passageLines.text: There are more than 300,000 of them living in Antarctica.
passageLines.ko: 30만 마리 이상의 황제펭귄이 남극에 살고 있습니다.

passageLines.text: Emperor Penguins have webbed feet, like a duck.
passageLines.ko: 황제펭귄은 오리처럼 물갈퀴가 있는 발을 가지고 있습니다.

passageLines.text: Their feet help them to swim.
passageLines.ko: 그들의 발은 헤엄치는 데 도움을 줍니다.

passageLines.text: They like to eat crabs and other types of shellfish.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 게와 다른 종류의 조개류를 먹는 것을 좋아합니다.

passageLines.text: On rare occasions, they might also eat a small fish or a squid.
passageLines.ko: 드물게는 작은 물고기나 오징어를 먹기도 합니다.

passageLines.text: Life is not easy for Emperor Penguins.
They have to go through the difficult Antarctic winter.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 혹독한 남극의 겨울을 견뎌야 합니다.

passageLines.text: Emperor Penguins spend their summers beside the ocean.
It is a good place to find food.
The Emperor Penguins are great swimmers.
They can dive to depths up to 250 meters.
They can hold their breath underwater for 20 minutes.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 물속에서 20분 동안 숨을 참을 수 있습니다.

passageLines.text: They can swim at speeds up to 9 kilometers per hour.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 시속 9킬로미터의 속도로 헤엄칠 수 있습니다.

passageLines.text: In March, the Emperor Penguins go on a long journey to their breeding grounds.
They go there to find a mate.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 짝을 찾기 위해 그곳으로 갑니다.

passageLines.text: This is a very difficult journey.
How can the penguins find their way to the breeding grounds every year?
passageLines.ko: 펭귄들은 어떻게 매년 번식지로 가는 길을 찾을 수 있을까요?

passageLines.text: Nobody knows for sure.
They must have very good instincts.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 아주 좋은 본능을 가지고 있음이 틀림없습니다.

passageLines.text: The breeding grounds are far away.
The Emperor Penguins have to walk more than 100 kilometers.
The journey takes one whole week.
The Emperor Penguins have to walk all night and all day.
Sometimes they slide on their bellies.
They have to stay together.
It is easy to get lost.
Lost penguins die.
The long journey to the breeding grounds can be very dangerous.
passageLines.ko: 번식지로 가는 긴 여행은 매우 위험할 수 있습니다.

passageLines.text: The Emperor Penguins have some fierce enemies.
passageLines.ko: 황제펭귄들은 몇몇 사나운 적들을 가지고 있습니다.

passageLines.text: Their scariest enemy is the Leopard Seal.
Leopard Seals are much bigger than penguins.
The Emperor Penguins are scared of the Leopard Seals.
Leopard Seals love to eat penguins.
passageLines.ko: 표범물범들은 펭귄들을 먹는 것을 아주 좋아합니다.

passageLines.text: They think penguins are delicious!
The ice at the breeding grounds is very thick.
The Emperor Penguins feel safe on the thick ice.
passageLines.ko: 황제펭귄은 두꺼운 얼음 위에서 안전함을 느낀다.

passageLines.text: The breeding grounds are surrounded by tall mountains.
The mountains protect the Emperor Penguins from cold winter winds.
Emperor Penguins are "serially monogamous.
This means they find a new mate every year.
passageLines.ko: 이것은 그들이 매년 새로운 짝을 찾는다는 것을 의미한다.

passageLines.text: Mating is a very exciting process.
The Emperor penguins sing mating songs.
They also perform mating dances.
There are usually more female penguins than male penguins.
passageLines.ko: 보통 수컷 펭귄보다 암컷 펭귄이 더 많다.

passageLines.text: Some females cannot find a mate.
Females without mates cannot lay eggs.
passageLines.ko: 짝이 없는 암컷은 알을 낳을 수 없다.

passageLines.text: It is easy for males to find mates.
They can choose from among many females.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 많은 암컷 중에서 선택할 수 있다.

passageLines.text: Female Emperor Penguins only lay one egg each year.
passageLines.ko: 암컷 황제펭귄은 매년 알을 한 개만 낳는다.

passageLines.text: Penguin eggs are quite a bit bigger than chicken eggs.
passageLines.ko: 펭귄 알은 닭 알보다 꽤 크다.

passageLines.text: They are usually 11 to 13 centimetres long.
They can weigh anywhere from 60 to 150 grams.
They get heavier as they mature.
They can be white or a slightly bluish-green color.
passageLines.ko: 그것들은 흰색이거나 약간 푸른빛이 도는 녹색일 수 있다.

passageLines.text: Emperor Penguins do not build nests.
They have to hold onto their eggs.
The egg fits under a flap on the mother's belly.
passageLines.ko: 알은 어미 배에 있는 주름 아래에 들어맞습니다.

passageLines.text: She has to balance the egg on her feet.
passageLines.ko: 어미는 알을 발 위에 올려놓고 균형을 잡아야 합니다.

passageLines.text: Her body keeps the egg warm.
passageLines.ko: 어미의 몸이 알을 따뜻하게 유지해 줍니다.

passageLines.text: The egg must not fall onto the ground.
Eggs can break very easily.
passageLines.ko: 알은 아주 쉽게 깨질 수 있습니다.

passageLines.text: A mother Emperor Penguin does not take care of her egg for very long.
passageLines.ko: 어미 황제펭귄은 자신의 알을 아주 오랫동안 돌보지 않습니다.

passageLines.text: Laying an egg is very hard work.
passageLines.ko: 알을 낳는 것은 매우 힘든 일입니다.

passageLines.text: She is very hungry.
She has to find some food.
She gives the egg to the father.
This is tricky.
They have to be careful.
The egg might drop.
The father Emperor Penguins take care of the egg for 2 months.
passageLines.ko: 아비 황제펭귄들은 두 달 동안 알을 돌봅니다.

passageLines.text: They don't have anything to eat except snow.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 눈 외에는 먹을 것이 아무것도 없습니다.

passageLines.text: This is the coldest part of the Antarctic winter.
passageLines.ko: 이때는 남극 겨울 중 가장 추운 시기입니다.

passageLines.text: It's hard to stay warm.
Several hundred penguins huddle together in a huge crowd.
passageLines.ko: 수백 마리의 펭귄들이 거대한 무리를 이루어 함께 몸을 웅크립니다.

passageLines.text: Each penguin carries an egg on his feet.
passageLines.ko: 각 펭귄은 발 위에 알을 품고 있습니다.

passageLines.text: The eggs hatch in May.
The baby penguins are called "chicks.
The chicks are very cute.
But there is a big problem.
The chicks are hungry.
But the father Emperor Penguins don't have any food.
passageLines.ko: 하지만 아비 황제펭귄들은 아무런 먹이도 없습니다.

passageLines.text: There isn't anything for the chicks to eat.
What can the fathers do?
The father penguins cough up a milky substance.
passageLines.ko: 아빠 펭귄들은 젖과 같은 물질을 게워냅니다.

passageLines.text: They feed the milky substance to the chicks.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 그 젖과 같은 물질을 새끼들에게 먹입니다.

passageLines.text: This might not sound very good to you.
passageLines.ko: 이것은 여러분에게는 별로 좋게 들리지 않을 수도 있습니다.

passageLines.text: But the chicks love it.
The milky substance is their first meal.
passageLines.ko: 그 젖과 같은 물질은 새끼들의 첫 식사입니다.

passageLines.text: It keeps them alive.
The fathers keep the chicks warm.
They wait for the mothers to return.
The mother Emperor Penguins return to the breeding grounds in July.
They have a problem.
They want to find their mates.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 자신의 짝을 찾고 싶어 합니다.

passageLines.text: But the breeding grounds are very crowded.
There are many penguins at the breeding grounds.
Everybody looks the same.
What can the mother Emperor Penguins do?
passageLines.ko: 어미 황제펭귄들은 무엇을 할 수 있을까요?

passageLines.text: How can they find their chicks?
passageLines.ko: 그들은 어떻게 자신의 새끼들을 찾을 수 있을까요?

passageLines.text: Each mother Emperor Penguin sings a special song.
passageLines.ko: 각 어미 황제펭귄은 특별한 노래를 부릅니다.

passageLines.text: The fathers listen to the songs.
This is how they find each other.
The mother's song is a way of saying, "Where are you?
I miss you!
The father's reply is a way of saying, "We are here!
passageLines.ko: 아비의 대답은 "우리는 여기 있어!"라고 말하는 방식입니다.

passageLines.text: Come this way!
Please hurry up!
The mothers spit food into the chicks' mouths.
passageLines.ko: 어미들은 새끼들의 입에 먹이를 뱉어 줍니다.

passageLines.text: It makes the chicks happy.
The father Emperor Penguins are hungry, too.
They want to go to the ocean right away.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 당장 바다로 가고 싶어 합니다.

passageLines.text: They want to go swimming.
They want to catch some fish.
They are starving.
Now the mothers have to look after the chicks.
The mother and father penguins feed their little chick.
passageLines.ko: 어미 펭귄과 아빠 펭귄은 어린 새끼에게 먹이를 줍니다.

passageLines.text: The weather gets warmer and warmer.
The chicks get bigger.
Summer eventually arrives.
This is a very happy time.
The Emperor Penguin families move back to the ocean.
The chicks are big now.
They can swim.
Now they can find food for themselves.
passageLines.ko: 이제 그들은 스스로 먹이를 찾을 수 있습니다.

lines.text: What are you going to do?

lines.speaker: B

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: He'll have a great time with them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are we going together?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, you guys are coming with us.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why are you going to the forest?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We're going there to watch insects.

lines.speaker: A

lines.speaker: A

lines.speaker: A

lines.speaker: B

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you going today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, it will be so much fun.
